title: Home Insurance Premium Weekly Billing Cycle Trend
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeinsurance:premium billing_cycle_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(billing_cycle_days) as avg_duration, max(billing_cycle_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst billing cycle for home insurance premium events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture billing_cycle_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average billing cycle with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether home insurance premium tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
